title: Rav Huna son of Rav Ilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yoma 35a. Hyman reports Dikdukei Soferim’s reading Rav Ulla son of Rav Ilai and says this Rav Huna is not found elsewhere in the Talmud.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The claim that this Rav Huna does not occur elsewhere in the Talmud is Hyman’s observation, not the result of a new exhaustive search. The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 35a has Rav Huna son of Rav Ilai.

The whole Davidson Yoma 35a paragraph fully names Rav Huna son of Rav Ilai. Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim Rav Ulla alternative remains an uncollated apparatus report. His statement that this Huna is not found elsewhere is his observation rather than a new exhaustive search. The source forms and existing note remain.
